Builds up a meter to smite enemies from above|Store Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Tesla''' is a mid-late game advanced tower which attacks enemies with chain lightning, temporarily immobilizing them. It can be bought for {{Coins|6,000}}. The '''Tesla''' fires lightning at enemies in its range. This lightning will extend to as many enemies as its max hits will allow it to, hitting the closest enemy to the initial target in a range of 12 at Level 0. These enemies will be stunned when hit, which stops them from moving. [[Boss]] and [[Stun Immunity]] enemies will only get slowed down instead. At Level 2+, it gains smite, an ability activated when its meter seen in the upgrade menu is filled up by hitting multiple enemies. This will unleash thunder on the targeted enemy, dealing explosion damage to it. The '''Tesla''' is an excellent option for stalling over a pretty large area, as its electric shocks can hold large crowds in place and give other towers more time to attack them, on top of dealing decent damage itself. The '''Tesla''' has a placement limit of two per player. ==Upgrades== {{Upgrade |Level = Level 1 |Upgrade Title = Kite in the Wind |Cost = {{Money|4,314}} |Image = [[File:TeslaLevel1.png|100px]] }} ==Skins== {| class="light-table align-center" style="width:500px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:GardenTeslaIconIG.png|175px]] |[[File:VoidborneTeslaIconIG.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|SpringFrenzy|Garden}} |{{Color|Void|Voidborne}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Legendary}} |{{Color|Rare}} |- !Daily Store Cost |N/A |N/A |- !Obtained From |[[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] |[[Void Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Tesla''' can be an effective mid to late-game AOE tower due to its chaining and smite. **While its range is rather average, its lightning has a high chain range, allowing it to chain to enemies that are very far away, though it still needs an enemy to attack in its main range for that to happen. **Its shock allows it to keep enemies in its and other tower's range for longer, allowing it to deal more damage to them. *The '''Tesla''' is essentially a larger version of the [[Electroshocker]], with a much higher chain radius, strong stuns and a smite explosion. It does however, have worse chain max hits, no defense melting and it is far more expensive. *At Level 2, the '''Tesla''' unlocks smite, which unleashes thunder on the targeted enemy once a damage meter is filled up. **This thunder creates an explosion, meaning it bypasses [[Defense]], making the '''Tesla''' more effective against such enemies. **The explosion from the smite is quite large and it has no damage drop off, which means that despite it only hitting three enemies with its chain, it can hit way more enemies with its explosion. *The '''Tesla''' shocks enemies when they are hit by its lightning, allowing it to be used as a stalling tower. **Do note that enemies with the [[Stun Immunity]] or [[Boss]] are only slowed down instead. *The '''Tesla''' can detect [[Flying]] and [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies, making it useful against hordes of such enemies. **While it does not have [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], its lightning can still chain to them if they are in its chain range, though this requires other enemies that can be targeted. ***Similarly, its explosion from smite also can hit these enemies. ==Trivia== *The Level 1 has two references: **The original upgrade cost is a reference to [[wp:Nikola Tesla|Nikola Tesla]]'s birth year. **The upgrade name "''Kite in the Wind''" is a reference to [[wp:Benjamin Franklin|Benjamin Franklin]]'s [[wp:Kite experiment|Kite experiment]]. *The Level 3 upgrade name is likely a reference to the [https://calamitymod.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Codebreaker#Components final upgrade for the Codebreaker] in the ''Terraria Calamity'' mod. **In addition, the overall color scheme resembles [https://calamitymod.wiki.gg/wiki/Auric_Bar auric] material from the mod. *The Level 4 upgrade name is a reference to [[w:c:callofduty:Staff of Lightning|Kimat's Bite]] from ''Call of Duty'' series. *The '''Tesla''' tower was originally set to release in September of 2025, but was delayed to November of 2025, later being delayed to its current release date of 28th of January 2026. **Stated reasons for the delays were the developers not being satisfied with the design and balancing of the tower[[File:TeslaDelayReason1.png|280px]]
